name: maxminddb-mcp
description: Look up IP locations and network ownership in local MaxMind databases.
long_description: Query GeoIP2, GeoLite2, or custom MMDB files. Use your MaxMind account to download and update databases, or select a folder containing existing files. Configure everything in the extension settings. Databases and credentials are not included. This is an unofficial project, not endorsed by MaxMind.

download_enabled.title: Download and update MaxMind databases
download_enabled.description: Download on first use and check for updates every 24 hours. Turn off to use existing MMDB files without a MaxMind account.

database_dir.title: Database folder
database_dir.description: With downloads off, select the folder containing your MMDB files. With downloads on, leave blank to use the application cache or choose a writable folder. Files are kept outside the extension when it is upgraded.

account_id.title: MaxMind account ID
account_id.description: Required when downloads are on. Find the account ID in your MaxMind account. Leave blank when using existing files.

license_key.title: MaxMind license key
license_key.description: Required when downloads are on. Claude stores this value as a sensitive setting. Leave blank when using existing files.

editions.title: Database editions
editions.description: Comma-separated edition IDs to download. Use editions available to your MaxMind account. Ignored when downloads are off.
